placements.frozen: Byte-exact 946 solver16 with the usual full H query.
placements.ordinary: Same-build 64+32 with 16 solver workers and tracing off.
placements.trace: Record final-output leaf entry, completion and H query entry.

calibration: Absolute paired median <=2% for ordinary vs frozen and <=3% for trace vs ordinary on each input.
diagnostics: Count final H coefficients by leaf. Measure time from coefficient readiness to final emission return, and the normal H start relative to the quotient return.
correctness: Fixed wires and matching public inputs, fresh external Gnark verification for each exported proof.
